output_list.criticism: The buy function allows anyone to buy tokens at a price set by the contract owner. The price is set by the owner using the setPrices function. If the owner set the buyPrice higher than the sellPrice, then the owner can buy tokens for less than the sellPrice. This will cause the tokens to devalue and the value of the tokens will be lost. The tokens should only be bought at a price that is equal to or lower than the sellPrice.
